thread.title: Here's How Much Warren Buffet Just Made in Apple Stock - Analyst of Finance

author: Joseph Roberts
title: Here's How Much Warren Buffet Just Made in Apple Stock - Analyst of Finance
text:
0 53
On Thursday, tech giant Apple became the first American publicly traded company to achieve $1 trillion in value and is up more than 20% in 2018. The stock’s high-point briefly touched $208.38 before depreciating a bit. This goal was reached because of the success of the newest iPhone variants: the 8 and X, respectively. Additionally, oversees App Store revenue has seen a massive surge, likely contributing to the company’s $1 trillion value.
What does this mean for investors in AAPL? Shareholders, especially those holding stock for a long time, are ecstatic. According to CNBC , if you invested $1,000 into AAPL ten years ago, you’d be looking at $9,222.50 today. That’s an almost one thousand percent increase in value.
For Warren Buffet, however, those numbers are looking much larger. His stake in the trend-setting company has been significant for some time now. Buffet’s company, Berkshire Hathaway, owned roughly 240 million shares of AAPL as of March. Assuming continuity of ownership, Buffet’s stake in Apple has increased by a whopping $2.7 billion since Thursday; another successful investment under the billionaire mogul’s belt.
It’s likely that Berkshire Hathaway didn’t sell before the company hit the $1 trillion mark. “I clearly like Apple. We buy them to hold,” Buffet said in an interview with CNBC . “We bought about 5 percent of the company. I’d love to own 100 percent of it. … We like very much the economics of their activities. We like very much the management and the way they think.” According to Business Insider, Buffet’s net worth currently sits at approximately $85 billion. He has given away $27 billion over the last ten years.
With the company’s stock price having healthy predictions, Warren Buffet and investors alike are expecting continued good results. According to CNN Money , “The current consensus among 41 polled investment analysts is to buy stock in Apple Inc. This rating has held steady since July, when it was unchanged from a buy rating.” SHARE
